# signalJourney examples

These two files are copied unchanged from `schema/examples/` of signalJourney at the commit named in `recipes/nemar_process/_vendor/signalJourney/SOURCE`.
`tests/images/test_sj.py` validates them with the vendored schema and shows that a record without `pipelineInfo` is rejected.
They are examples from the upstream project (BSD 3-Clause, see the `LICENSE` beside the vendored schema), not NEMAR records.
